description: The stacked bar chart illustrates the "Number of Experts" allocated across 24 sequential categories labeled "Layer". The horizontal category axis displays discrete numerical values from 1 to 24 in sequential order. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of Experts" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. Each bar is stacked with three components, representing different categories as indicated by a top-center legend. The bottom component of every bar is colored blue, corresponding to a legend entry showing a blue square next to an unlabeled grey rectangle. The middle component is colored green and labeled "G1", and the top component is colored yellow and labeled "G2". The blue component maintains a constant value of 1 across all 24 layers. The green (G1) and yellow (G2) components vary in height depending on the layer. The tallest overall stacked bar occurs at Layer 1, reaching a total value of 9 (composed of 1 blue, 4 green, and 4 yellow). The shortest overall stacked bars are found at Layers 7, 11 through 15, 23, and 24, each with a total value of 3 (composed of 1 blue, 1 green, and 1 yellow). The bars are ordered sequentially by layer number rather than by total height, and no specific bars are visually emphasized.
